queries.text: The author coins "apaixonador" (the one who makes others fall in love; the active element) and uses "apaixonante" for the victim who falls in love (07-0012, 07-0016, 07-0020). Rendered as "enamorer" and "enamored victim/party." Alternatives: "the one who inspires passion" / "the infatuated party." Proposed for the glossary.
